reason: Adds a DSH web UI panel that aggregates and displays Write/Edit file diffs for each completed conversation turn, with per-file grouping and host file navigation.

summaries.zh: 在每轮对话结束时汇总并展示 Write/Edit 工具产生的文件差异，提供按文件分组的可折叠面板和文件跳转。
summaries.en: Aggregates Write/Edit tool diffs at the end of each conversation turn and displays them in a collapsible, per-file panel with file navigation.

capabilities: Aggregates file diff hunks from Write/Edit tool results within a conversation turn
Renders an expandable per-turn diff panel in the DSH web interface
Uses the host file opener when a displayed file path is clicked
